metadata.description: Red pixel lettering spells COUPA. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Open constellation surround the motif, with stepping stones along the lower route. 3 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 4 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
